observations: The 960x540 HUD is substantially smaller than at 1280x720. Its round fields remain visible, but this review does not certify comfortable readability on a physical display.
The center notice remains explicitly labelled INSPECTION FIXTURE even on the result captures. It is fixture context, not evidence of a gameplay event notification.
Duplicate TRAV name prefixes are distinguishable by P1/P2/P3/P4, and local identity is separately marked YOU. Full names are intentionally not shown in the standings.
limitations: This is agent review of saved static images, not a human playtest or physical-display acceptance.

The capture harness uses production drawing and a real tied-timeout transition, but hosting mode, participant admission, scores, death and clocks are authored fixtures. No sockets, real remote peers or earned knockout flow are established by these images.
The local 1.8-second countdown and six-second return label are inspected at selected instants; continuous countdown progression is not demonstrated here.

The native contact board samples explicit distance phases, not elapsed-time motion. It verifies visible selected poses and registration, not animation feel, cadence, frame pacing, input responsiveness or rendered performance.
Normal/reduced equality is limited to these captured fixtures and phases; it does not establish behavior for every character, action or effect.
The board uses existing contacts and repeated neutral passing poses. It does not add or certify missing sidestep/backpedal art, held-jump animation, or complete action coverage.

No engine, full regression, network, installer, release or deployment validation was performed by this reviewer. The receipt's 48 checks are recorded as supplied engine evidence, not independently rerun evidence.
